cat > programs/task-d9d1ad27.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    sixes = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 6]
    # Join diagonal 1-markers; any 6 marker on the segment remains and
    # extends along its perpendicular diagonal to the grid edge.
    for i, (r1,c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2,c2 in ones[i+1:]:
            if abs(r2-r1) != abs(c2-c1):
                continue
            dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else -1
            dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1
            for k in range(abs(r2-r1)+1):
                r,c=r1+dr*k,c1+dc*k
                if grid[r][c] != 6:
                    out[r][c]=1
            for r,c in sixes:
                # seed lies on segment, in its interior
                if (r-r1)*dr >= 0 and (r-r2)*dr <= 0 and abs(r-r1)==abs(c-c1) and (c-c1)*dc >= 0 and (c-c2)*dc <= 0:
                    # perpendicular slope: if segment has slope +1, use -1 and vice versa
                    slope = -1 if dr == dc else 1
                    for rr in range(h):
                        cc = c + slope*(rr-r)
                        if 0 <= cc < w:
                            out[rr][cc]=6
    return out
PY
